name: s7plus
description: Connect to Siemens S7-1200/1500 PLCs over S7CommPlus with symbolic addressing: tags are addressed by name (e.g. DB_OUT.GoodParts), so optimized data blocks work and PUT/GET does not need to be enabled. Values are pushed by PLC-side subscriptions at the point group's poll rate.

security.title: Security
security.description: tls for TIA Portal V17+ firmware (S7-1200 V4.5+, S7-1500 V2.9+); legacy for older firmware

password.title: PLC Password
password.description: Only if the CPU's access protection requires a password to read; leave empty otherwise

mode.title: Acquisition
mode.description: subscribe: the PLC pushes changes each cycle (recommended); poll: batched reads each cycle

address.title: Symbol
address.description: The tag's symbolic name as shown in TIA Portal: <DataBlock>.<Member> (e.g. DB_OUT.GoodParts, Motor_DB.axis[2].speed) or a global PLC tag by name (e.g. AlwaysTRUE). Quote names containing a dot: "Clock_0.5Hz". The tag must be accessible from HMI/OPC UA.

dataType.title: Data Type
dataType.description: Informational — the type is read from the PLC's symbol table
